description: The .NET Framework assembly behind classic ASP.NET (`HttpContext`, modules, handlers), which does not exist on modern .NET.
The `HttpApplication` subclass whose `Application_Start` registers routes, filters and bundles, replaced by `Program.cs` in ASP.NET Core.
The XML file that holds app settings, connection strings, `system.web` options and IIS modules, varied per environment with transform files.
The Web API 2 base class in `System.Web.Http`, separate from the MVC 5 `Controller` in `System.Web.Mvc`, with its own routing, filters and dependency resolver.
The Web API 2 action result interface (`Ok`, `NotFound`), replaced by `IActionResult` and `ActionResult<T>` in ASP.NET Core.

A static accessor to the current request that is null outside the request context and is not part of ASP.NET Core; the System.Web adapters can supply it during a migration, but the goal is an injected `HttpContext` or `IHttpContextAccessor`.
A class implementing `IHttpModule`, registered in `web.config` and hooked to request events, whose role middleware takes over in ASP.NET Core.
